title: Empty subset differs from the singleton in $\mathrm{Fin}\,1$
statement: Regarding the one-element index set $\mathrm{Fin}\,1 = \{0\}$, the empty subset $\emptyset$ and the singleton subset $\{0\}$ are distinct as finite subsets of $\mathrm{Fin}\,1$.
hypotheses_covered: none — bare inequality of two explicit finite sets
replaced: The empty subset of $\mathrm{Fin}\,1$ is not equal to $\{0\}$.
